activation_signals: Problem defines an energy functional J over H^{1,s}(R^n) or similar Sobolev space with L^p nonlinear terms and coupling.
Problem involves: Pohozaev identity, mountain pass geometry, fiber map, Pohozaev manifold P(a,b), L²-norm constraint.
Answer format is multi-part (a)/(b)/(c) True/False; Yes/No — qualitative structural verdicts, NOT explicit formula.
Key vocabulary: ground state solution, Pohozaev manifold, fiber map, scaling transformation that preserves L^2 norm, mountain pass level.
problem_signatures: 给出各向异性Sobolev空间H^{1,s}(R²)中的能量泛函J，带L^p非线性项与耦合项β∫|u|^{r1}|v|^{r2}。
问题格式为多小题(a)/(b)/(c) True/False; Yes/No，考察泛函结构性质：能量下无界性、临界点存在性、正基态、约束极值唯一性。
核心概念：Pohozaev恒等式、山路定理、纤维映射(fiber map)、Pohozaev流形P(a,b)、二阶条件φ''(1)<0。

likely_failure_modes.description: Pohozaev identity mis-scoped: treating P(u,v)=0 as merely necessary rather than equivalent to (u,v) being a critical point of J.
likely_failure_modes.observed_in: 1728(a): model answered False (P=0 → not necessarily critical point), GT=True.
likely_failure_modes.fix: In the coupled anisotropic Schrödinger system, P(u,v)=0 IS equivalent to critical point membership — apply the equivalence directly.

likely_failure_modes.description: Fiber map uniqueness denied: model claims no unique t>0 exists mapping (u,v) onto the Pohozaev manifold.
likely_failure_modes.observed_in: 1728(b): model answered No (unique t doesn't exist), GT=Yes.
likely_failure_modes.fix: Standard fiber map theorem: for any non-zero (u,v)∈H^{1,s}, the function φ(t)=J(u_t,v_t) has exactly one critical point t*>0, placing (u_{t*},v_{t*}) on P.

likely_failure_modes.description: Mountain pass critical point not recognized as ground state in the L²-constrained framework.
likely_failure_modes.observed_in: 1727(b): model answered No (critical point doesn't imply positive ground state), GT=Yes.
likely_failure_modes.fix: In the L²-norm-preserving scaling setup, the mountain pass level equals the ground state energy; the critical point obtained IS a positive ground state by symmetrization.

likely_failure_modes.description: Uniqueness of constrained minimizer answered incorrectly by applying wrong exponent range criterion.
likely_failure_modes.observed_in: 1727(c): answer was correct (No for r1+r2 ∈ (2,2s)), but the boundary condition must be tracked carefully.
likely_failure_modes.fix: Uniqueness holds for r1+r2 ∈ (2s, 2+2s). Fails (non-unique or not established) for r1+r2 ∈ (2, 2s). Check exact range in problem statement.

key_theorems: Pohozaev identity: For solutions (u,v) to the coupled anisotropic Schrödinger system, P(u,v) = s·(kinetic) - (scaled nonlinear terms) = 0 at critical points.
Fiber map theorem: φ(t) = J(u_t,v_t) has a unique critical point t*>0 for any non-zero (u,v); (u_{t*},v_{t*}) ∈ P.
Mountain pass theorem: Under AR condition and Palais-Smale compactness, the mountain pass level c = inf_γ max_t J(γ(t)) > 0 is a critical value.
Ground state = minimizer of J on P(a,b): In the L²-constrained setting, the ground state energy equals the mountain pass level.
Second-order condition: If (u*,v*) minimizes J on P(a,b), then φ''(u*,v*)(1) < 0 (the fiber map is strictly concave at t=1).
Scaling exponent threshold: J_t unbounded from below iff p > 2(1+3s)/(1+s) (L²-supercritical condition for the anisotropic space).

sop_phases.title: Phase A — Framework Card
steps: Identify Sobolev space (H^{1,s}, s parameter, space dimension n=2).
Write energy functional J explicitly: kinetic H^{1,s} norm + L^p/L^q nonlinear terms + coupling term.
Identify: mass constraints (a,b), exponent parameters (p,q,r1,r2,s), scaling transformation.

sop_phases.title: Phase B — Pohozaev Identity Check
steps: Write P(u,v) = s·(kinetic norms) - (nonlinear terms scaled by exponents).
Apply equivalence: P(u,v)=0 ⟺ (u,v) is a critical point of J (NOT just necessary).
Apply fiber map: unique t*>0 s.t. (u_{t*},v_{t*})∈P for any non-zero (u,v).

sop_phases.title: Phase C — Energy Coercivity & Mountain Pass
steps: Compute scaling: how J(u_t,v_t) behaves as t→+∞. Kinetic ∝ t^{2s}, L^p term ∝ t^{p(1+s)/2 - 2}.
Unbounded below iff nonlinear exponent exceeds critical: p > 2(1+3s)/(1+s).
Mountain pass geometry: verify AR condition (or linking) and Palais-Smale compactness.

sop_phases.title: Phase D — Ground State & Uniqueness
steps: Mountain pass → ground state: in L²-constrained setting, mountain pass level = ground state energy → critical point is positive ground state.
Uniqueness check: r1+r2 ∈ (2s, 2+2s) → unique; r1+r2 ∈ (2, 2s) → not unique.
Second-order condition: minimizer on P(a,b) satisfies φ''(1) < 0.

sop_phases.title: Phase E — Answer Normalization
steps: Answer each sub-part (a)/(b)/(c) in the problem's exact format.
Emit only the verdict string — no prose, no fences.

output_rules: Multi-part (a)/(b)/(c): use exact format '(a) True/False; (b) Yes/No; (c) Yes/No.' matching problem separator style.
No markdown, no explanation in the final answer.
If a sub-part asks for a formula (rare), use problem's variable names exactly.
